skill_name: Describe the impact of cloud computing on business operations.
workflow: Cloud computing has had a significant impact on business operations. Cloud computing has made information and data more accessible, allowing companies to quickly share and access up-to-date information between departments and locations. Additionally, cloud computing has allowed teams to collaborate in real-time, allowing for faster decision-making and reducing time to market.
